tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Positive login test

steps.step: Enter valid username and password

tests.expected_result: System logs user in successfully

tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Negative login test - invalid username

steps.step: Enter invalid username and valid password

tests.expected_result: System rejects login attempt with error message

tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Boundary login test - empty password

steps.step: Enter valid username and empty password

tests.expected_result: System rejects login attempt with error message

tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Workflow login test - multiple attempts

steps.step: Enter valid username and password, then try again with same credentials

tests.expected_result: System logs user in successfully after second attempt

tests.requirement: User can search patient by name
tests.title: Positive patient search test

steps.step: Enter valid patient name in search field

tests.expected_result: System returns list of matching patients

tests.requirement: User can search patient by SSN
tests.title: Positive patient search test - SSN

steps.step: Enter valid patient SSN in search field

tests.expected_result: System returns list of matching patients

tests.title: Positive patient profile test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their profile

tests.expected_result: System displays patient's demographics, visit history, and medical history

tests.title: Positive encounter record test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their encounter records

tests.expected_result: System displays list of encounter records with details

tests.title: Positive logout test

steps.step: Click the logout button

tests.expected_result: System logs user out successfully

tests.title: Negative logout test - invalid session

steps.step: Try to log out with an invalid session

tests.expected_result: System rejects logout attempt with error message

tests.title: Boundary logout test - no session

steps.step: Try to log out with no active session

tests.expected_result: System displays error message indicating no active session

tests.title: Workflow logout test - multiple attempts

steps.step: Try to log out, then try again with same credentials

tests.expected_result: System logs user out successfully after second attempt

tests.title: Positive patient demographics test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their demographics

tests.expected_result: System displays patient's demographics information

tests.requirement: User can view patient visit history
tests.title: Positive patient visit history test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their visit history

tests.expected_result: System displays list of patient's visits with details

tests.title: Positive encounter record test - multiple records

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their multiple encounter records

tests.expected_result: System displays list of encounter records with details

tests.title: Positive patient medical history test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their medical history

tests.expected_result: System displays list of patient's medical conditions with details

tests.title: Positive patient prescription test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their prescriptions

tests.expected_result: System displays list of patient's prescribed medications with details

tests.title: Positive clinical notes test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and add new clinical notes

tests.expected_result: System adds new clinical notes to patient's record

tests.title: Positive prescription test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and prescribe new medication

tests.expected_result: System adds new prescription to patient's record

tests.title: Positive allergy test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and check for allergies

tests.expected_result: System displays list of patient's known allergies with details

tests.title: Positive appointment overview test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their appointment schedule

tests.expected_result: System displays list of patient's upcoming appointments with details

tests.requirement: User can access control for patients
tests.title: Positive patient access control test

steps.step: Select a valid patient from search results and view their access controls

tests.expected_result: System displays list of patient's access controls with details

tests.title: Negative logout test - invalid session (again)

steps.step: Try to log out with an invalid session again

tests.expected_result: System rejects logout attempt with error message

tests.title: Boundary logout test - no session (again)

steps.step: Try to log out with no active session again

tests.expected_result: System displays error message indicating no active session

tests.title: Workflow logout test - multiple attempts (again)

steps.step: Try to log out, then try again with same credentials again

tests.expected_result: System logs user out successfully after second attempt
